name: Indian passport
fullName: Indian passport photo for Passport Seva uploads
intro: When an Indian passport application asks for a digital photo, for example when applying from abroad through Passport Seva Global, it must be exactly 630 × 810 pixels on a plain white background.

documents.label: Passport photo
notes: Exactly 630 × 810 pixels, JPG, between 10 KB and 250 KB.
Plain white background only; cream, off-white and light grey are rejected.
Colour photo showing your head and the top of your shoulders, with your face filling most of the frame.
Printed copies are 35 × 45 mm. Check your Passport Seva Kendra or mission for its current instructions.

source.label: Embassy of India, Astana passport renewal instructions (pixel size) and a photo-requirements site (file size)

faqs.q: What is the Indian passport photo size in pixels?
faqs.a: 630 × 810 pixels, JPG, on a plain white background. The printed size is 35 × 45 mm.

faqs.q: Is a 2 × 2 inch photo accepted for an Indian passport?
faqs.a: No. Indian passports use the 35 × 45 mm size; the older square 2 × 2 inch size is no longer accepted.
